# Moon Gleam AI Studio

> London AI video production studio. AI-powered videos that grow UK businesses —
> full production from brief to delivery for 500+ UK businesses. Slogan: "Powered by Creative AI."

## What we do
- AI-powered video production (fully AI, filmed with real models, or hybrid)
- TV commercials (TVCs) — produced to broadcast standard, clearance-ready delivery
- Business promotion videos and product promotional videos
- UGC & social content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)
- Documentary (brand, heritage and historical series)
- Kids animation (3D animated stories, songs, educational content)
- Short film & drama

## Who we serve
UK SMBs and organisations: law firms & solicitors, accountancy firms, charities & non-profits,
education & training providers, retail (shops, grocers, jewellers, restaurants), travel & tour
operators. 500+ UK businesses served. Portfolio includes Bombay Jewellers, Lawmatic Solicitors,
Bluestone Travel, Ansarey Travels, QNS Academy, HRF and Cuisine Artist.

## Why Moon Gleam
- Broadcast production standards combined with creative AI
- Broadcast quality at a fraction of traditional cost and time (most projects in days, not months)
- Full production in-house: concept, script, storyboard, production, edit, grade, sound, delivery
- Transparent pricing in GBP: social packs from £499, promo videos from £1,499, TVCs from £3,999
